bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to Fishing with Vets.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FISHING WITH VETS.

$25,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $25,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Fishing with Vets, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to organize and conduct guided fishing trips for veterans across Minnesota.
additions: $25,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $25,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Fishing with Vets, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to organize and conduct guided fishing trips for veterans across Minnesota.
